description.value: A full-service, RV-oriented campground at the heart of E.C. Manning Park in the Cascades, open year-round with flush washrooms, a playground, and optional resort pool and hot-tub access for a fee; the hookup-heavy layout skews toward RVs, but tent campers share the same modern facilities and can walk to Lightning Lake in 10 minutes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at manningpark.com/camping/ provides detailed information specifically about Skyview RV Campground, confirming it as a year-round, full-service RV campground with 92 serviced sites offering 15/30/50-amp power, water and sewer hookups, a modern washhouse, and WiFi. EV charging is explicitly noted as available at Manning Park Resort adjacent to the campground. No mention of tent sites, hiker/biker sites, or walk-in camping is found anywhere in the website content, indicating this is primarily an RV-focused facility.
concerns: OSM name is 'Skyview Campground' but website consistently refers to the facility as 'Skyview RV Campground' — OSM name may need updating.
No phone or address in OSM record; Skyview-specific phone (1-604-668-5954) and address (7500 HWY #3, Manning Park, BC) sourced from website only.
No mention of tent sites, hiker/biker sites, or walk-in camping found anywhere in website content — facility appears exclusively RV/full-hookup serviced.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Skyview is a legitimate, well-equipped year-round campground in Manning Provincial Park with potable water, electrical hookups, showers, nearby food, and EV charging — meaningful amenities for touring cyclists despite its primary RV orientation.
enrichment_extras.notes: Reservations for Skyview must be made directly with Manning Park Resort (not BC Parks), unlike all other Manning Park campgrounds. General resort contact: 1-604-668-5922 / info@manningpark.com.

wow_evidence: optional resort pool and hot-tub access for a fee...year-round
